confidence_notes: FX is the RBA AUD/USD figure for 18 Nov 2026, found through search. Food and drink anchors rest on one search of crowd-sourced cost-of-living sites (mylifeelsewhere, Traveltables). These sites disagree with each other and some figures are dated. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price and typical Australian pub and restaurant relationships, not from direct Wollongong data. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. Hostel and 1-star prices are the least certain because Wollongong has few hostels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Wollongong's crowd-sourced price data, and on its similarity to other NSW coastal regional cities such as Newcastle and Gold Coast-type markets. Wollongong is slightly cheaper than Sydney.
